full_unit_read.coverage: Stream/chalk map; peepal/red flag/Budhi Maa; dung/cowshed/granary; carts/divided measure/walls; separation question; double door/water-eaten memory; bride/beloved with wounds and want; tree/name/leaf; lifted feet/winter/leaf touch; invitation and absent I.

findings.evidence: Current Hindi title and village references use contextual टोली; खिलखिलाती, पहनती, सजती and final की preserve feminine personification. English She/herself retains bride/secret beloved.
findings.judgment: These are already integrated batch022 fixes, not new edits. Relayed poet feedback supports this exact context; no universal गाँव-to-टोली rule or complete author approval inferred.

findings.evidence: Both targets keep wounds and want as ornaments, the heart-to-heart question, rural smell/material, feet lifting with thought of you, and final marked I/absence.
findings.judgment: Do not sanitize hardship, turn the question into instruction or assert that absence necessarily means death. Literary strangeness may be deliberate.

evidence: Intended relation between person/tree/name/leaf in stanza8.
Does गउणि/ଗଉଣି here mean a grain measure/vessel, divided provision, or another local sense? Dictionary meanings do not establish this particular line.
Are the lyric speaker and addressee intended to be gendered? The existing Hindi first-person feminine and second-person masculine remain provisional.
Wall/door spatial relation remains provisional; water से गली emphasizes decay and awaits poet feedback.
The regional settlement sense of टोली follows relayed author suggestion; final contextual wording remains open.
findings.judgment: Hindi छू जाऊँगी and गुज़रोगे/सकोगे still specify participants provisionally. Village femininity does not settle participant gender. Budhi Maa deity context, tree/name/leaf and divided measure remain source-context questions; Hindi water से गली and doorway relation remain provisional.

findings.evidence: edition-pages.py selects edition-art-direction before legacy quiet-path assignment. Current source points to two-leaves-of-a-door-v1.webp, whose filename retains v1 although bytes derive from selected master v2.
findings.judgment: Review the effective association and actual hash, not legacy assignment or filename version alone.

findings.evidence: Original master v1 and current public artwork compared at normal size. Current image removes paired invented wavy/triangular marks, retains rectangular joinery, plausible attached hinges/latch, unequal door angles, lower wood wear, soft courtyard light and pale wall space.
findings.judgment: Doorway evokes one remembered stanza without illustrating every noun or inventing the actual village, sacred symbols or people. Human absence is a purposeful interpretation, not a missing translation line. Material wear arises from old wood; avoid escalating decay as an aesthetic recipe.
